name: Register or update mobile number in Aadhaar
name_hi: आधार में मोबाइल नंबर पंजीकृत / अपडेट करना
description: Register a mobile number with Aadhaar (or change it) at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. A registered mobile number is needed for Aadhaar online services.
description_hi: आधार नामांकन केंद्र पर आधार के साथ मोबाइल नंबर पंजीकृत करें (या बदलें)। आधार की ऑनलाइन सेवाओं के लिए पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर ज़रूरी है।
verification_notes: UIDAI says a mobile number not registered at enrolment is registered at a Permanent Enrolment Centre; the update fields include Mobile Number. UIDAI's page does not list a supporting document for a mobile update, so none is modelled beyond the Aadhaar number. The Aadhaar app also offers Mobile Number Update; its own requirements are not modelled.
